wiki_overview.content:
<blog>

# Logistic Tracker - Cross-Border Logistics Tracking Platform

## Project Introduction

### Purpose Statement
Logistic Tracker is a comprehensive cross-border logistics tracking platform designed to provide real-time visibility into international shipping movements. The platform aggregates tracking data from multiple carrier APIs and presents it through a unified interface, supporting over 900+ carriers worldwide.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Universal Tracking Coverage**: Support for major international express and postal carriers including DHL, FedEx, UPS, SF Express, and China Post
- **Real-Time Visibility**: Live tracking updates with intelligent caching and status monitoring
- **Developer-Friendly**: RESTful API with comprehensive documentation and SDK support
- **Scalable Architecture**: Microservice-based design supporting high-volume traffic and enterprise-scale deployments

### Target Audience
- **Individual Users**: Shippers and recipients tracking international packages
- **Business Users**: E-commerce platforms, logistics companies, and supply chain managers
- **Developers**: Integration partners requiring API access for tracking functionality

## Technical Architecture

The project follows a modern monorepo architecture with clear separation between frontend, backend, and shared utilities:

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph "Monorepo Structure"
        A[apps/web] --> C[Next.js Frontend]
        B[apps/api] --> D[Fastify Backend]
        E[packages/shared] --> F[Shared Types & Constants]
        
        C --> G[React Components]
        D --> H[API Routes]
        F --> I[Type Definitions]
        
        G --> J[UI Components]
        H --> K[Business Logic]
        I --> L[Data Models]
        
        J --> M[Tracking Timeline]
        K --> N[Carrier Adapters]
        L --> O[Shipment Types]
    end
    
    subgraph "External Services"
        P[17track API]
        Q[AfterShip API]
        R[Redis Cache]
        S[Carrier APIs]
    end
    
    N --> P
    N --> Q
    N --> R
    N --> S
```

### Component Breakdown

**Frontend Layer (apps/web)**
- Next.js 16 application with App Router
- React 19 with TypeScript
- TailwindCSS for styling
- Lucide React icons library

**Backend Layer (apps/api)**
- Fastify microservice with TypeScript
- Redis caching layer
- Rate limiting and CORS middleware
- Modular adapter pattern for carrier integrations

**Shared Layer (packages/shared)**
- Type definitions for shipments and tracking events
- Constants for carrier detection and caching
- Internationalization utilities

### Design Patterns

The architecture implements several key design patterns:

1. **Adapter Pattern**: Pluggable carrier adapters for different logistics providers
2. **Repository Pattern**: Unified data access through tracking service
3. **Caching Strategy**: Intelligent Redis-based caching with status-aware TTL
4. **Microservice Architecture**: Separation of concerns between frontend and backend

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Frontend Application**
- [`apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx`](apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx) - Root layout with provider setup
- [`apps/web/src/lib/api.ts`](apps/web/src/lib/api.ts) - API client utilities

**Backend Service**
- [`apps/api/src/server.ts`](apps/api/src/server.ts) - Fastify server initialization
- [`apps/api/src/routes/track.ts`](apps/api/src/routes/track.ts) - API route definitions

### Core Modules

**Tracking Service**
- [`apps/api/src/services/tracking-service.ts`](apps/api/src/services/tracking-service.ts) - Central orchestration logic
- [`apps/api/src/services/carrier-detect.ts`](apps/api/src/services/carrier-detect.ts) - Carrier identification logic

**Carrier Adapters**
- [`apps/api/src/adapters/base-adapter.ts`](apps/api/src/adapters/base-adapter.ts) - Adapter interface definition
- [`apps/api/src/adapters/17track-adapter.ts`](apps/api/src/adapters/17track-adapter.ts) - 17track API integration
- [`apps/api/src/adapters/aftership-adapter.ts`](apps/api/src/adapters/aftership-adapter.ts) - AfterShip API integration
- [`apps/api/src/adapters/mock-adapter.ts`](apps/api/src/adapters/mock-adapter.ts) - Development/testing adapter

**Shared Types and Constants**
- [`packages/shared/src/types/index.ts`](packages/shared/src/types/index.ts) - Core data structures
- [`packages/shared/src/constants/index.ts`](packages/shared/src/constants/index.ts) - Configuration values

### Configuration Approach

**Workspace Configuration**
- [`pnpm-workspace.yaml`](pnpm-workspace.yaml) - Monorepo workspace definition
- [`package.json`](package.json) - Root scripts and dependencies
- [`tsconfig.base.json`](tsconfig.base.json) - Base TypeScript configuration

**Environment Configuration**
- [`apps/api/.env.example`](apps/api/.env.example) - Environment variable examples
- [`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml) - Container orchestration

### External Dependencies

**Frontend Dependencies**
- Next.js 16 for SSR and static generation
- React 19 with hooks and concurrent features
- TailwindCSS for utility-first styling
- Lucide React for consistent iconography

**Backend Dependencies**
- Fastify 5 for high-performance HTTP server
- ioredis for Redis caching integration
- @fastify/cors and @fastify/rate-limit for security middleware

**Development Tools**
- TypeScript 5 for type safety
- ESLint for code quality
- TailwindCSS 4 for styling

### Integration Points

**Carrier API Integrations**
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant API
    participant Adapter
    participant Carrier
    
    Client->>+API: Track Request
    API->>+Adapter: Route Request
    Adapter->>+Carrier: API Call
    Carrier-->>-Adapter: Tracking Data
    Adapter-->>-API: Normalized Response
    API-->>-Client: Shipment Details
```

**Caching Strategy**
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Tracking Request] --> B{Cache Hit?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Return Cached Data]
    B -->|No| D[Detect Carrier]
    D --> E[Route to Adapter]
    E --> F[Fetch from Carrier API]
    F --> G[Normalize Data]
    G --> H[Cache with TTL]
    H --> I[Return Response]
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Real-Time Tracking**
- Multi-carrier tracking from 900+ logistics providers
- Live status updates with intelligent caching
- Comprehensive event timeline with location data

**Batch Processing**
- Concurrent batch tracking up to 50 shipments
- Parallel processing with configurable concurrency
- Detailed failure reporting for invalid tracking numbers

**Internationalization**
- Multi-language support (Chinese/English)
- Localized status descriptions and carrier names
- Flexible locale switching

### Implementation Highlights

**Adaptive Carrier Detection**
- [`apps/api/src/services/carrier-detect.ts`](apps/api/src/services/carrier-detect.ts) - Intelligent carrier identification using regex patterns
- Supports major carriers including DHL, FedEx, UPS, SF Express, and China Post

**Intelligent Caching**
- [`apps/api/src/services/tracking-service.ts`](apps/api/src/services/tracking-service.ts) - Status-aware caching with TTL optimization
- Redis-based cache with graceful degradation when unavailable

**Responsive Frontend**
- [`apps/web/src/components/Header.tsx`](apps/web/src/components/Header.tsx) - Modern navigation with language switching
- [`apps/web/src/components/TrackingTimeline.tsx`](apps/web/src/components/TrackingTimeline.tsx) - Interactive timeline visualization

### Feature Architecture

**State Management Flow**
```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Loading: User Input
    Loading --> Success: Valid Tracking
    Loading --> Error: Invalid Input
    Success --> Displaying: Render Timeline
    Error --> Idle: Reset Form
    Displaying --> Idle: Clear Search
```

**Data Flow Architecture**
```mermaid
graph LR
    A[User Input] --> B[Frontend Validation]
    B --> C[API Request]
    C --> D[Tracking Service]
    D --> E[Carrier Detection]
    E --> F[Adapter Selection]
    F --> G[Carrier API Call]
    G --> H[Data Normalization]
    H --> I[Cache Update]
    I --> J[Response Formatting]
    J --> K[Frontend Display]
```

**Performance Optimization**
- [`apps/api/src/services/tracking-service.ts`](apps/api/src/services/tracking-service.ts) - Parallel processing with concurrency limits
- [`apps/api/src/adapters/base-adapter.ts`](apps/api/src/adapters/base-adapter.ts) - Consistent response format across carriers
- [`packages/shared/src/constants/index.ts`](packages/shared/src/constants/index.ts) - Optimized cache TTL values per status

---

**Sources:**
- [package.json](package.json)
- [pnpm-workspace.yaml](pnpm-workspace.yaml)
- [apps/web/package.json](apps/web/package.json)
- [apps/api/package.json](apps/api/package.json)
- [packages/shared/package.json](packages/shared/package.json)
- [apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx](apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx)
- [apps/api/src/server.ts](apps/api/src/server.ts)
- [apps/api/src/routes/track.ts](apps/api/src/routes/track.ts)
- [apps/api/src/services/tracking-service.ts](apps/api/src/services/tracking-service.ts)
- [apps/api/src/adapters/base-adapter.ts](apps/api/src/adapters/base-adapter.ts)
- [packages/shared/src/index.ts](packages/shared/src/index.ts)
- [packages/shared/src/types/index.ts](packages/shared/src/types/index.ts)

</blog>
